data.title: Bitcoin Breaches $75,000 For The First Time Since May Amid Crypto Surge
data.description: The crypto surge comes after President Trump called for the passage of the long-stalled CLARITY Act and the Treasury intervened in the bond market—boosting appetite for risky bets.
data.author: Siladitya Ray
data.keywords: Crypto Surge,Bitcoin price,Bitcoin at 75000,Clarity Act,Treasury Department bond intervention
